title: Flatten Multi-File Crates And Packages Into Single lib.rs Index.ts Entries
description: Repo-wide sweep to flatten multi-file Rust crates and JS/TS packages down to a single entry file (lib.rs, index.ts/index.tsx), following up on the earlier script.ts consolidation ticket. Scan found 17 multi-file Rust crates (31 extra .rs files, e.g. fsm/rs with 7, puzzle/plugin/rs and cad/plugin/rs and fsm/macros/rs with 4 each) and 47 multi-file TS/TSX packages (190 extra files, largest being mathematical/graph/manifest at 17, framework/renderer/react at 16, repo/server/coordinator at 15). Merge sibling/submodule files into each crate's lib.rs (using inline `mod foo { ... }` blocks to preserve module boundaries/privacy) or package's index.ts/index.tsx (using `#region`/`#endregion` comment blocks), deleting the merged-in files and fixing all internal relative imports plus any external importers that reference the old sub-file paths directly. Explicitly SKIP and document rationale for structurally-required splits: compose/client/ui/desktop and coda/client/ui/desktop (Electron apps, main/preload/renderer run in separate JS processes/contexts), compose/client/ui/vscode (extension host vs webview run in separate contexts), mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage (routed web app, files likely map to routes), framework/product/os/dev/renderer-modules/wgpu/asset (contains generated codegen output under generated/, mixed concern), repo/client/vscode/.vscode-test/* and .repo/cache/vcpkg/* (vendored/downloaded, not our source). Verify each merged crate with cargo check and each merged package by grepping for stale import paths plus a build/typecheck where feasible.
summary:
Finished the flatten sweep: consolidated the 6 remaining multi-file Rust crates, 2 TS packages, and the C# Compose tree into single files, following the established `mod x;` → inline `mod x { ... }` / import-merge pattern from the earlier phase of this ticket.

Rust (all verified with `cargo check -p <crate>` + `cargo test -p <crate>`, plus a final `cargo check --workspace`):
- fem/core/rs: 6 sibling files inlined into lib.rs (77 tests pass).
- animate/video/rs: 6 sibling files inlined (8 tests pass).
- animate/present/rs: nested present/{mod,compiler,slide}.rs folded into lib.rs as `pub mod present { ... }`, present/ deleted (11 tests pass).
- animate/core/rs: 17 `#[path="src/x.rs"]` modules inlined, src/ deleted (46 tests pass).
- energy/engine/rs: 50 `#[path="src/x.rs"]` modules inlined, src/ deleted (178 tests pass). Volatile — re-diffed against the concurrently-active WAVE-12 session immediately before merging (its work had landed as commits by the time I merged).
- architect/program/rs: 14 sibling modules inlined into src/lib.rs, then moved to lib.rs at the crate root per convention (`[lib] path` updated in Cargo.toml), src/ deleted (37 tests pass). Also volatile/re-diffed for the same reason.

TypeScript:
- animate/present/core/js: internal.ts (2175 lines) spliced into index.ts between the Header and Play regions; vitest.config.ts include/includeSource updated; internal.ts deleted (112 tests pass).
- framework/renderer/react: os-shell.tsx, ui-interpreter.tsx, and 15 components/*.tsx (13 planned + 2 new ones — diff-view-host.tsx, event-feed-host.tsx — added by a concurrent session mid-ticket) merged into index.tsx. Imports deduplicated and reformatted with prettier. Resolved real name collisions: kept one `hostLabel` (4 identical copies), one `useClient` (2 identical), ink-canvas's `parseSelectionIds`/`screenToWorld`/`worldToScreen` (superset signatures, and the only ones index.test.ts imports), world-3d's guarded `parseJsonArray`; renamed node-graph's internal-only `screenToWorld`/`worldToScreen` to `dagScreenToWorld`/`dagWorldToScreen` (8 call sites). Rewrote all 14 `lazyHost(() => import(...))` dynamic imports to `lazyHost(() => Promise.resolve({ X }), "X")`. Updated index.test.ts (single `./index.tsx` import), script.ts's region-balance/host-contract lint (now scans index.tsx directly), and fixed downstream consumers: .storybook/framework/os/index.tsx, .storybook/stories/puzzle/2d/Board.stories.tsx (added missing `UiComponentSceneNode` re-export to index.tsx's type re-export line for this), repo/lib/js/index.test.ts's region-balance test, plus stale doc-comment references in ui/js/react/index.tsx and framework/core/js/index.ts. 170 tests pass; lint passes.

C#:
- compose/client/lib/net/Compose: converted Compose.cs's file-scoped `namespace Compose;` to block form; merged in ComposeDiff.Wire.cs, KitInPlaceDiff.cs, KitState.cs as regions, and the 6-file Store/ directory as a `namespace Compose.Store { ... }` region; deleted the merged files and Store/. Discovered and fixed the underlying reason the tree didn't build (no csproj included Store/ despite Compose.cs using it): repaired Compose.csproj's Elements.Styling reference, Compose.Tests' ProjectReference, and the Monorepo.sln `Compose`/`Compose.Tests` entries (were doubled `cs\cs\`, now correct single-segment paths).
- Merged StoreClientTests.cs into Compose.Tests/cs/Tests.cs; deleted all three Usings.cs (`global using Xunit;`) across Compose.Tests, Rhino.Tests, Grasshopper.Tests, adding the one missing `using Xunit;` line to Grasshopper.Tests/Tests.cs.
- `dotnet build -f net8.0` on the merged Compose.csproj surfaces 12 pre-existing compile errors (KitDiff.Types/.Designs/.ShouldSerializeTypes/.ShouldSerializeDesigns not found) confirmed to originate entirely within the ORIGINAL, unmoved Compose.cs base content (a partially-completed concurrent Typologies refactor left KitDiff's own `implicit operator KitDiff(Kit kit)` and ApplyTypesDiff/ApplyDesignsDiff call sites — both well outside anything this ticket touched — using the old `Types`/`Designs` API that KitDiff's field list no longer has). Confirmed not introduced by this merge; already flagged as a separate follow-up task (task_eaaa0434) rather than fixed here, since it requires understanding the unrelated Typologies refactor's intended shape.

Final repo-wide grep for stale references to every old path (Rust src/ files, renderer/react/components, ./internal.ts, Compose/Store) returned zero hits.

Helper scripts used (kept in the ticket folder): merge_rust_modules.py, merge_ts_package.py, and per-crate JSON configs.
